name: Almanac
description: Sample playbook: an editorial, paper-and-ink system. Flat surfaces, hairline borders, one warm accent. Replace with your own.

paper.role: Page background. The default surface. Never use pure white.

paper-2.role: Recessed surface: table header, hover fill, sidebar.

ink.role: Primary text, strong borders, secondary button outline.

ink-3.role: Meta text: timestamps, helper text, captions.

accent.role: The single call-to-action colour. Primary button, active nav, focus ring.

display.use: Page titles, section headings, big numbers. Weights 500-600.

mono.use: Tabular numbers, IDs, code, keyboard hints.
